snippet.title: Virtual Training Ship - STEAM Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Our educational game, Virtual Training Ship (LITE) will be releasing soon on STEAM!

Our ‘Virtual Training Ship’ is an educational game designed for maritime professionals, maritime colleges and academies and those curious in life at sea on a modern ship.

In this ‘lite’ version you need to gather all the correct documentation to show you are properly qualified before you can join your ship.

You then need to make yourself familiar with your ship as you explore the deck and engine room. 

Detailed ‘info boxes ‘will give you a description of some of the critical equipment you will find on a modern vessel.

Finally, you can complete the challenge of carrying out maintenance of the ship’s boiler under the watchful eye of one of the engineering officers!

Find and Wishlist Virtual Training Ship here: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2506080/Virtual_Training_Ship/

This edition is intended as a showcase piece for custom content which we can create. If you would like to discuss Onboard Maritime creating a playable maritime scenario for you, please contact us at: info@onboardmaritime.com
